test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Based on the alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which of the following does NOT belong to that group?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- 

 
• First and second letter ⇒ Difference between the position values according to English alphabetic series is (3).
 
• Second and third letter ⇒ Difference between the position values according to English alphabetic series is (1).

​So,

 
• Option - (1) : PSR

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a783d61d9dd4a75b530d48846c783f6d9fe8355631840d16fc805b85e76e4988.png] 

 
• **Option - (2) : TUX**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4bb272a9fe2af9fbd3a9494d00f65d06bfe905116642dde7173a862ed9e3e60a.png] 

 
• Option - (3) : MPO

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7530fce57c4319bf69eb19a86fa9f5fc954190e210627a6bb3b63f5dc5a10968.png] 

 
• Option - (4) : YBA

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f61a973a0d01a7cd49e8bed4a955f187723acb68a04382877542841a75c62369.png] 

​Hence, "TUX" is the correct answer.
